en.sayed-ali-raza: (Remember) I have still the sword with which I dispatched your grandfather, your mother’s brother and your brother to one and the same place.
By Allāh, I know what you are. Your heart is sheathed and your intelligence is weak.
It is better to say that you have ascended to where you view a bad scene which is against you, not in your favour,
because you are searching a thing lost by someone else, you are tending someone else’s cattle and you are hankering after a thing which is not yours nor have you any attachment with it.
